Hard-coding crypto JSON in controllers or tests while leaving API services equities-scoped.

Removing or weakening existing equities API assertions.
hard_constraints: Do not add new diagnostics endpoints.

Keep the change compact and read-only.
Preserve equities behavior for domain=equities and omitted domain.

Omitted domain and domain=equities return existing equities metadata. domain=crypto returns crypto runtimeConfigVersion, graphId, live config, partition state, venue list, and diagnostics metadata without adding routes or mutation APIs.

candidate.problem_statement: Implement read-only crypto-domain parity for existing GET /api/config/* and GET /api/diagnostics/* endpoints so domain=crypto returns crypto runtime metadata while domain=equities and omitted-domain callers preserve current equities behavior.
risk_register: Endpoint inventory risk: a config or diagnostics route may be missed unless QA enumerates every existing route before implementation claims parity.
Default-domain regression risk: changing parameter parsing could alter existing callers that omit domain.
Fallback-path risk: diagnostics helpers may already have partial domain-aware methods while some paths still call no-domain or equities-only readers.

Metadata-source risk: crypto runtime metadata may be missing or named differently; implementation must use existing crypto projections or existing unavailable/null semantics, not hard-coded equities substitutes.
UI proxy risk: Playwright may pass selector state while backend requests still omit domain if assertions are too shallow.
Read-only boundary risk: config initialization shortcuts could accidentally introduce mutation behavior contrary to the feature constraints.
Regression risk: full regression may expose unrelated failures; reviewer and QA must separate unrelated failures from R-003 acceptance blockers.

task_slices.objective: Lock the R-003 contract for app-api config and diagnostics domain handling, enumerate existing /api/config/* and /api/diagnostics/* routes, and map runtime metadata fields to equities and crypto sources before tests or implementation change.

Add failing app-api and Playwright coverage proving every existing config and diagnostics endpoint returns equities metadata for domain=equities and crypto metadata for domain=crypto, including default-domain, invalid-domain, leakage, and mixed-request isolation cases.

Thread request-scoped domain resolution through app-api config and diagnostics controllers, services, DTOs, and any needed UI selector propagation so existing endpoints return domain-correct runtime metadata without adding routes, mutations, persistence, or QA writes.

Review the app-api, UI, docs, and authored tests for R-003 contract compliance, read-only boundaries, endpoint inventory completeness, equities regression risk, crypto leakage risk, and absence of new diagnostics or config mutation APIs.

Run final R-003 verification after review using app-api tests, Chromium Playwright domain-switch coverage, smoke, and full regression while only writing QA artifacts under registered QA and test roots if evidence updates are needed.
